posts.title: Chery's Huawei-backed Luxeed to get independent carmaking license, plans IPO
posts.summary:
Luxeed is set to obtain its own production license, and an insider said the Chery unit plans to go public independently in the future.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Luxeed, the EV brand partnership between Huawei and Chery, is set to receive an independent carmaking license following a production capacity transfer from Chery Group.
The brand plans to transition its vehicle badging from 'Chery' to 'Luxeed' once the regulatory approval process concludes.
An insider confirmed that the business unit, which has operated with separate accounting since 2024, is preparing for an independent public listing in the future.

posts.title: BYD's all-new Han and third-gen Qin Plus appear in filings as core sedan refresh continues
posts.summary:
The all-new Han measures more than 5.1 meters long, an increase of 161 mm over the Han EV Flash Charging Edition launched in April.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD is refreshing its core sedan lineup with an all-new Han and a third-generation Qin Plus, as revealed in recent Ministry of Industry and Information Technology filings.
The new Han model features significantly larger dimensions, with a length of 5,156 mm and a wheelbase of 3,030 mm, and offers high-performance dual-motor AWD variants with up to 520 kW of peak power.
The refresh is a strategic response to declining sales in the Han series, which saw a 70.9% year-on-year drop in September.

posts.title: Xpeng expands GX shipments overseas as Middle East orders exceed 3,000
posts.summary:
Xpeng's overseas sales exceeded 10,000 vehicles for the first time in September, with global markets accounting for a growing share of total deliveries.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xpeng has begun volume shipments of its flagship GX SUV to the Middle East and Africa, with over 3,000 orders already secured in the Middle East region.
International markets have become a critical growth engine, with overseas sales exceeding 10,000 units in September and accounting for over 20% of total deliveries year-to-date.
The expansion of the GX, alongside the recent launch of the G9L in Europe and the Mona L03 in Oceania, highlights Xpeng's aggressive strategy to offset domestic delivery declines.

posts.title: VW updates ID. UNYX 06 and 07 in China with LiDAR, lower entry prices
posts.summary:
The ID. UNYX 07 now starts at 99,900 yuan ($14,860), the first time Volkswagen has priced a fully electric model in China below 100,000 yuan.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Volkswagen Anhui has updated the ID. UNYX 06 and 07 models, lowering entry prices by 20,000 yuan compared to their May launch.
The ID. UNYX 07 Lite variant is now priced at 99,900 yuan, marking the first time a Volkswagen pure-electric model has dropped below the 100,000 yuan threshold in China.
New variants feature LiDAR-based driver-assistance systems powered by Horizon Robotics' Journey 6H chip, enabling advanced Navigation on Autopilot (NOA) capabilities.

posts.title: GAC Aion opens pre-sales for first Ray model, targeting younger buyers
posts.summary:
Ray 7 pre-sales start at 128,800 yuan ($19,160), with a CLTC range of up to 702 km.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: GAC Aion has opened pre-sales for the Ray 7, the first model in its new series, with prices ranging from 128,800 to 158,800 yuan.
The vehicle integrates Huawei's DriveONE electric drive system across all variants, with higher-end trims featuring LiDAR for urban and highway navigation assistance.
The model offers two battery options, including a 62.98-kWh pack from CATL that provides a maximum CLTC range of 702 kilometers.
